first_purchase_strategy.round_0: Measure/photograph and identify on-hand components, workbench position, safe power/ventilation and Dremel bits; prevent duplication.
first_purchase_strategy.round_1: Buy or restore exactly one tested functional FDM printer, the minimum suitable filament, calibration/measurement and applicable safety supplies not already owned.
first_purchase_strategy.round_2: Print non-safety-critical fixture, Dremel tool rack, arm prototype links and registration jigs; measure and keep failure DBRs.
first_purchase_strategy.round_3: Acquire/repurpose motors, controllers, rated power and sensors only after geometry and torque/load calculations; perform low-energy no-heat arm trials.
first_purchase_strategy.round_4: Evaluate independent hotend purchase vs disassembly/repurposing of an affordable pen using measured heater/thermal sensor/continuous-duty and regulation; don't buy both without benefit.
first_purchase_strategy.round_5: Safe arm extrusion proof, second arm, tool exchange and eventually professionally engineered sealed process chamber. Butter Bot full sealed build is later.
